verdict.rationale: Bugbot's documented 'Fix in Cursor' and 'Fix in Web' links send each finding straight to the Cursor IDE or Cursor's cloud agents at cursor.com/agents. That satisfies the 'direct integration with Cursor' branch of the story, and the inline comments carry suggested fixes. The handoff is locked to Cursor's own tools, and the docs say little about what context gets passed along. missing for 10: copyable agent-ready fix prompts, handoff to Claude Code or Codex, detail on what context the fix links pass, independent or hands-on corroboration of the handoff flow.
